strategy: Focus on War Plans activities like Helltide and the Pit while maintaining difficulty at Hard or above for XP multipliers. Prioritize imprinting powerful Legendary Aspects early (especially the Amulet), and use Combo Points with Flurry to maintain high Heartseeker attack speed throughout leveling.
